text: So. if i gather what you said correctly. if u removed the old characters route. the existing one would break
resolution: Answered the route-coupling question with source-backed import data: /workbench does not directly mount CharactersRoute, but it imports many modules from editors/characters (preview, paintKit, grabKit, smoothKit, gridData, draft, generate, roster, animPresets, regions). Therefore deleting only the /characters route entry/component would not inherently break /workbench, but deleting the old editors/characters module tree would break /workbench, /items, /cutout, and paint/workbench consumers. No code changed.
